summary_en: This study is testing giredestrant, a pill, in people with estrogen receptor positive, HER2 negative early breast cancer who could not tolerate prior aromatase inhibitor treatment. Giredestrant is taken by mouth at 30 mg once daily on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 4.5 years or until disease recurrence or unacceptable toxicity, whichever comes first. The study looks at treatment adherence, tolerability, and patient-reported outcomes, and it is a Phase IIIb, single-arm, open-label study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa giredestrant, una píldora, en personas con cáncer de mama temprano positivo para receptor de estrógeno y negativo para HER2 que no toleraron un tratamiento previo con inhibidores de la aromatasa. El giredestrant se toma por vía oral a 30 mg una vez al día, los días 1 al 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, durante hasta 4.5 años o hasta que ocurra una recurrencia de la enfermedad o toxicidad inaceptable, lo que ocurra primero. El estudio analiza la adherencia al tratamiento, la tolerabilidad y los resultados reportados por los pacientes, y es un estudio de Fase IIIb, de un solo brazo y abierto.
who_for: Postmenopausal women with ER-positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer, stage I to III.
Prior adjuvant aromatase inhibitor use for at least 6 months, including 3 consecutive months before consent.
Participant and investigator agree current aromatase inhibitor symptoms are intolerable and warrant a switch.
Grade 2 or 3 adverse events judged by the investigator to be linked to aromatase inhibitor intolerance.
not_for: Prior fulvestrant or any oral selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD).
Rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, or other inflammatory connective tissue disease.
Active cardiac disease or history of cardiac dysfunction.
Child-Pugh Class B or C liver disease, active viral hepatitis, current alcohol abuse, or cirrhosis.
Strong CYP3A inhibitors or inducers within 14 days or 5 drug elimination half-lives before study treatment.
